data_errors: The catalogue entry bundles two reserves that appear as two separate Wilson orders in the USGS compilation (No. 680 Clackamas River, Oregon; No. 681 Snake River, Idaho); to be confirmed from the page images.
The date 1918-04-24 is seen in the 1976 catalogue OCR for PSR 681 (Idaho) only; the dates on the orders themselves were not legible.

The Oregon catalogue rows under project 1716 that the earlier research read as PSR 680 and 681 are dated 04-28-17 and sit in a run 619, '680', '621/681', '682', each with RST 412 of 06-28-26. They are probably PSR 620, 621 and 622 with the digit 2 misread as 8, not the 1918 reserves. Not confirmed from the image; the earlier proposition p8 built on them is withdrawn.
Acreage for PSR 681 differs between the catalogue (257) and the earlier OCR reading of the transmittal letter (287); probably an OCR misread, not checked against the image.
In the Idaho PSR 681 block one row's reserve number is OCR'd 661 (RST 319, 07-01-22); the compilation OCR also prints the order number as 661 and 642.

review.conclusion_reason: OPEN and formal status unknown are appropriate: no verified ending or positive cutoff-date source is supplied. Missing original images and later-action scope are specifically identified. This does not validate the unverified catalogue assertions.
missed_evidence: Both withdrawal texts expressly limit their reach to lands whose title remains in the United States; the clause summaries omit this qualification. Location: cited powersitereserve04geol OCR, PSR 680 continuation and PSR 681 continuation (fetched lines 41034–41038 and 41145–41158).
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed — WEB fits the first gap: original page images remain unread, the archive item/image endpoints failed retrieval, and the evidence-slice PDF exceeded the fetch size limit. No accepted original was inspected.
review.suspected_defect: Unsupported classification of restoration as partial solely because acreage was unread; also p2 labels a partly normalized quotation as uncorrected OCR. Intent cannot be determined.

verdicts.reason: Cited compilation identifies Volume 4, 501–765 and explicitly indexes 680 as Clackamas River, Oregon and 681 as Snake River, Idaho.
Withdrawal substance is supported, but the purported uncorrected quotation silently repairs the fetched OCR. The text also qualifies withdrawal by title remaining in the United States.
Fetched OCR gives 1920 and an unclear statutory page. Correction to 1910 and 847 is plausible but cannot be confirmed without the image.

PSR 680 context contains Wilson's name with OCR corruption, an unreadable order date, and the APR 24 1918 referral stamp. This confirms the OCR-level claim, not an original signature or execution date.
Snake River, Idaho order and continuation headed 661 in OCR expressly reserve lands for water-power sites; quoted wording has minor OCR differences.
Wilson's name is confirmed, but fetched OCR reads June 25, 1919 (36 Stat., G47), not the quoted clean statutory citation. Image verification is missing.
Catalogue text retrieval failed; supplied PDF exceeded the tool's size limit. Date and acreage could not be checked.
Unread acreage does not establish partial restoration. The restoration row itself also could not be independently retrieved.
Catalogue retrieval failed, preventing confirmation of the modification, interpretation, acreage and Oregon rows.
Neither reserve's alleged 1971 row could be checked against the unavailable catalogue.

stop_code_verdict: confirmed — WEB fits the first gap: original page images remain unread, the archive item/image endpoints failed retrieval, and the evidence-slice PDF exceeded the fetch size limit. No accepted original was inspected.
